sentences: Earlier this week, Japan **launched** a spacecraft on a long trip to Phobos, one of the two small moons of Mars.
The spacecraft is expected to reach Mars in August 2027 and will stay near the planet for about three years.
During that time, it will land on Phobos twice and collect a small **sample** of about ten grams of rock and dust.

Scientists, who have argued about this moon for many years, hope the sample will show **whether** Phobos was **formed** after a giant crash on Mars or was an **asteroid** captured by the planet's **gravity**.
en.answer: 이번 주 초, 일본이 화성의 두 작은 위성 중 하나인 포보스로 가는 긴 여행길에 우주선을 발사했다.
